title: Tales of the RED: Hope Reborn
description: Campaign-level state graph for Hope Reborn. It encodes the canonical six-mission sequence and campaign continuity while mission beat conversion remains independently versioned.
recommendedCharacters: New street-level Edgerunners; campaign assumes roughly 60 IP per session and supports combat and non-combat solutions.
premise: A street-level campaign centered on the Forlorn Hope and the difference a Crew can make for one community.
publicBackground: The Forlorn Hope can become the Crew's home base and a community worth protecting.
gmBackground: The six missions are interconnected and designed to occur in order, with later missions building on earlier outcomes; individual missions may branch and contain optional Beats.
openingSituation: Establish the Crew's connection to the Forlorn Hope before the first mission begins.

startDefinition.openingSituation: Introduce the Forlorn Hope as a recurring home base and establish at least one personal connection when possible.

locations.name: The Forlorn Hope
locations.descriptionPublic: A veteran-centered Night City bar that can become a second home for the Crew.
locations.descriptionGM: Recurring campaign hub; emotional connection to its staff/patrons strengthens campaign motivation.
locations.arrivalDescription: The Hope is a place to recover, hear rumors, meet patrons, and find the next thread.

rumors.content: Each mission has its own rumor table; rumors can be learned through a Media's Credibility or street gossip at GM discretion.

objectives.title: Protect and strengthen the Hope's community
objectives.description: Play through the interconnected campaign while preserving Crew agency and the consequences of each mission.

scenes.purpose: Establish the campaign hub and Crew connection without forcing a personal backstory.
knownFacts: The Hope is a recurring campaign hub.
The campaign is designed as six interconnected missions.

events.content: Hand control to The Angel's Share mission module when its detailed beat graph is available.
Advance campaign continuity to Real Estate Rumble.
Advance campaign continuity to Welcome to the Neighborhood.
Advance campaign continuity to The Devil's Cut.
Advance campaign continuity to Hope's Calling!!!.
Advance campaign continuity to Ripping the Ripper.

gmGuidance: Run missions in campaign order by default because later missions build on earlier events.
Never force optional Beats or a branch the Crew did not choose.
Use each mission's flowchart/beat graph as structure, not as a railroad.
Rumors and Infobox knowledge remain gated by their mission rules and appropriate checks when the GM chooses to require them.
The fourth mission emphasizes cunning, social skills, and stealth; do not convert every obstacle into combat.
